title: Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt: An Executable Outcome Contract for Distributed Agent-Tool Gateways
abstract: arXiv:2610.15991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributed agent workflows cache delegated authority at tool gateways. Revocation may be reported at issuer commit, transport acknowledgment, or receiver persistence, although none of these observations establishes that all gateways enforced the change or that guarded effects stopped. We define C0-C5, a bounded outcome contract spanning issuer commit through effect prevention, and implement it as a persistent monitor over a frozen gateway set, call set, and observation window. A 14-case fault matrix checks conservative classification, sticky violations, restart persistence, and evidence immutability. In a derived audit of its eight semantic cases, treating C3 or C4 as completion produces seven or five false positives, respectively; the bounded C0-C5 verdict produces none. Descriptive scaling covers 1,024 gateways and 10,000 effect vectors. The primary experiment uses the maintained Keycloak 26.7 identity server and measures the contract

translated_title: 撤销在接收时并未完成：面向分布式代理-工具网关的可执行结果契约
translated_abstract: 分布式代理工作流会在工具网关处缓存委托授权。撤销可能在签发方提交、传输确认或接收方持久化时被报告，但这些观察结果均无法证明所有网关都已执行了该变更，也无法证明受保护的效果已经停止。我们定义了C0-C5，这是一个有界结果契约，涵盖从签发方提交到效果阻止的完整过程，并将其实现为一个持久监视器，运行在冻结的网关集合、调用集合和观察窗口之上。一个包含14个用例的故障矩阵检验了保守分类、违规粘性、重启持久性和证据不可变性。在其八个语义用例的衍生审计中，将C3或C4视为完成状态会分别产生七个或五个误报，而基于C0-C5的有界判定则不产生任何误报。描述性扩展测试覆盖了1,024个网关和10,000个效果向量。主要实验使用维护中的Keycloak 26.7身份服务器，并对该契约进行测量。
tldr: 针对分布式代理-工具网关中撤销状态无法真正确认的问题，提出C0-C5有界结果契约及持久监视器，将撤销完成的判定从签发方或传输层确认推进到效果阻止层面，实验表明将中间状态视为完成会产生多个误报而该契约判定无误报。
en_tdlr: The paper defines C0-C5, an executable bounded outcome contract implemented as a persistent monitor that verifies revocation is enforced across all distributed agent-tool gateways up to effect prevention, showing that treating intermediate states (C3/C4) as completion produces false positives while the bounded verdict produces none.
